title: Versioned offline speech bridge for VideoML hosts
description:
## Behavior
A VideoML host can keep one local Auritus process alive and send versioned NDJSON capabilities and synthesis requests without login, AWS, or an HTTP server.

## Canonical contract
Coordinated by VideoML/toolchain issue videoml-f4f9f3 (P13), under initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D06/D07 and P02 schemas in VideoML/specification. Wrap existing auritus.speech.synthesize, Voice and SpeechOptions; do not copy model backends or alter hosted content_hash.

## Implementation
Add cli/src/auritus/speech_bridge.py executable as python -m auritus.speech_bridge. Protocol v1 supports capabilities and synthesize, correlates IDs, returns structured recoverable errors while staying alive, reserves stdout for JSON and stderr for diagnostics, writes WAV/metadata atomically, reports model identity/revision and capability readiness without downloading weights. Unknown/missing backends or models fail explicitly, never produce stand-in audio or paid fallback. Fatal protocol/process errors exit nonzero; clean EOF exits zero.

## Acceptance
Begin with features/speech_bridge.feature and behavior steps. Verify capabilities; good request / recoverable error / good request in one process; stdout cleanliness; invalid fields and paths; explicit fake backend for protocol tests; missing models and unsupported options; atomic artifact metadata and measured samples. Run required quality gates. Real Kokoro validation is separate VideoML P16, not satisfied by mock speech.

## Coordination
Terra worker edits product code; primary owns board, review and integration. Do not close until primary accepts evidence. The open speech library initiative remains the native parent; VideoML board holds cross-repository execution order.

comments.text: Implementation accepted by primary and Terra review at 5836302; product PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Auritus/pull/91 targets develop. Literal make check passed (250 behavior scenarios, 5 skipped); primary independently passed all11 bridge scenarios. Model/voice pinning and reload, native fd stdout isolation, atomic directory publication reviewed and fixed. Tests use explicit simulated/injected audio; real offline Kokoro remains separate P16 acceptance. Runtime capability probe correctly reports installed=true/ready=false for missing cached model. Keep story in_progress until PR lands. README documents new protocol and limitations.
